lines.serbian: Sedmi je januar, i kod Milice je pun stan.
lines.croatian: Sedmi je siječnja, i kod Milice je pun stan.
lines.english: It's the seventh of January, and Milica's flat is full.

lines.serbian: Njen sin je prvi put doveo devojku iz Danske, a Milica je kuvala tri dana.
lines.croatian: Njezin sin je prvi put doveo djevojku iz Danske, a Milica je kuhala tri dana.
lines.english: Her son has brought his girlfriend from Denmark for the first time, and Milica has been cooking for three days.

lines.serbian: – Dobro došli! Hristos se rodi! – kaže Milica.
lines.croatian: – Dobro došli! Hristos se rodi! – kaže Milica.

lines.serbian: – Odgovara se: „Vaistinu se rodi“ – šapuće sin svojoj devojci.
lines.croatian: – Odgovara se: „Vaistinu se rodi“ – šapuće sin svojoj djevojci.
lines.english: "The answer is: 'Truly he is born'," the son whispers to his girlfriend.

lines.serbian: Anna pokušava da ponovi, ali joj ne ide.
lines.croatian: Anna pokušava ponoviti, ali joj ne ide.
lines.english: Anna tries to repeat it, but it doesn't go well.

lines.serbian: Milica je vodi do stola i objašnjava svako jelo.
lines.croatian: Milica je vodi do stola i objašnjava svako jelo.
lines.english: Milica leads her to the table and explains every dish.

lines.serbian: – Ovo je česnica, naš božićni hleb. Negde u njemu je skriven novčić.
lines.croatian: – Ovo je česnica, naš božićni kruh. Negdje u njemu je skriven novčić.
lines.english: "This is česnica, our Christmas bread. A coin is hidden somewhere inside it."

lines.serbian: – Ko ga pronađe, imaće sreće cele godine.
lines.croatian: – Tko ga pronađe, imat će sreće cijele godine.
lines.english: "Whoever finds it will have luck all year."

lines.serbian: – Ovo je pečenica, pečenje koje spremamo za Božić.
lines.croatian: – Ovo je pečenica, pečenje koje spremamo za Božić.
lines.english: "This is pečenica, the roast we make for Christmas."

lines.serbian: – A ovo je sarma. Moraš da probaš barem dve.
lines.croatian: – A ovo je sarma. Moraš probati barem dvije.
lines.english: "And this is sarma. You have to try at least two."

lines.serbian: Pre jela svi zajedno lome česnicu rukama.
lines.croatian: Prije jela svi zajedno lome česnicu rukama.
lines.english: Before eating, everyone breaks the česnica together with their hands.

lines.serbian: Anna u svom komadu pronalazi novčić.
lines.croatian: Anna u svom komadu pronalazi novčić.
lines.english: Anna finds the coin in her piece.

lines.serbian: Svi tapšu, a Milica je ljubi u oba obraza.
lines.croatian: Svi plješću, a Milica je ljubi u oba obraza.
lines.english: Everyone claps, and Milica kisses her on both cheeks.
"I knew it! Now you're one of us!"

lines.serbian: Anna proba jednu sarmu, pa drugu, pa treću.
lines.croatian: Anna kuša jednu sarmu, pa drugu, pa treću.
lines.english: Anna tries one sarma, then a second, then a third.

lines.serbian: – Ne mogu više, hvala – kaže posle pete.
lines.croatian: – Ne mogu više, hvala – kaže nakon pete.
lines.english: "I can't eat any more, thank you," she says after the fifth.

lines.serbian: – Kako ne možeš? Nisi ništa jela! – odgovara Milica.
lines.croatian: – Kako ne možeš? Nisi ništa jela! – odgovara Milica.
lines.english: "What do you mean you can't? You haven't eaten anything!" Milica replies.
